cL220.role: PRIMARY: the known-log base at the cost-model optimum K_opt = 220 (analysis/cost_model.json), the first 220 scalars of the same seeded stream

cL600.role: known-log base at K600 (the baseline's orbit count): 600 seeded scalar orbits R_j = [a_j]G, generated cold in every process, logs known by construction, read by the baseline's producer as a retained base with KIC_LOG_TABLE_IN; no rank stage, no LA

cLX.role: planted control (Q0 only): cL220 with log column 1 moved off by one before the producer reads it; the producer must refuse it

cLaa.role: A/A control: a second process of cL220 on every point

cP.role: IC baseline cold arm, in this session for pairing: the rank-probe producer's cold path (koblitz-n83-rankprobe-20261019 arm cP, the n=83 baseline row) on B's K600 base with B's verified cached factor-log table, run by that experiment's arm.py unchanged

kP.role: IC baseline rank stage (arm kP of koblitz-n83-rankprobe-20261019: KIC_RANK_SOLVE=frame), run by that experiment's arm.py unchanged; its factor-log table must equal B's

rT.role: tuned rho rT770 (Fold/64/DP6), the strongest one-target rho at n=83, same points

controls_pass_rule.aa: E2E cL220 / cLaa (ratio of means over the cold points, paired) inside [0.97, 1.03]
controls_pass_rule.planted: cLX on Q0: the producer refuses the table with column 1 off by one (nonzero exit, the panic 'factor log 1 does not map G to its representative', no scalar); and the independent verifier fails each of its three planted corruptions

probe_law_band.note: per arm over the 40 cold points: mean probes / law inside [0.5, 1.5] and no point above 20x the law (2,400 archived rank attempts average 0.9785 of the law with coefficient of variation 0.97; under an exponential law a 40-point mean leaves [0.5, 1.5] with probability below 0.01, and one point exceeds 20x with probability e^-20)

design.process_model: one point per process, fresh processes per run, one pinned CPU, one runner
design.runtime_estimate: from run 39214027289 and the cost model: build and tests about 15 min; a cold segment about 60 s (cP about 23 s, cL600 about 23 s, cL220 and cLaa about 6 s each, rT about 3 s); a rank block (one kP process) about 175 s; O1 about 80 s; total about 1.2 h
design.time_guard: skip a segment (rows skipped_time_guard) if elapsed + its estimate exceeds 200 min

gates: every scheduled row valid (exit 0, verified, schedule match, no memory event)

before timing: check_knownlog.py (pinned pure-Python oracle, no shared code with the generator or the producer) verifies, for the runner-built generator's K600 and K_opt outputs, every log [a_j]G = R_j, the scalars against the declared rule, every base point as +-phi^s(R_j) with label +-lambda^s, distinct orbits and the base hash, and the files' SHA-256 against knownlog.bases; and detects all three planted corruptions

every known-log process: the files its own generator wrote hash to the verified ones; the producer reads them as a retained header, skips the rank stage and verifies every [L_j]G = R_j before target work (verified_columns = K); 83 K^2 logical states, (83 K^2 + K)/2 stored, the compact table with the slot count of the stored states, the frozen root-table entries and index digests of that base
per point: one scalar across every IC process (cP, kP, cL600, cL220, cLaa) and rT, replayed as [d]G = Q in the pinned oracle
per point: one relation and one probe count within each base (cP with kP on B's base; cL220 with cLaa)
Q0 (O1): cP gives the archived Feistel identity (1,987,852 probes); cL600, cL220 and cLaa give the frozen identity of their base
kP: full rank and the written factor-log table equal to B's archived table (the baseline arm's own checks)
probes inside the law band: for cP, cL600 and cL220, the mean over the cold points of probes / (r / (166 * 83 * K^2)) inside [0.5, 1.5], and no point above 20

k_choice.label: prediction, not a measurement
k_choice.rule: the even multiple of 10 nearest model A's integer minimum (multiples of 20)

220.source: generated by knownlog_base 220 20261019; digests, index digests, root-table entries and the Q0 identity from the local smoke (smoke/smoke_local.json; exact, deterministic)

600.source: generated by knownlog_base 600 20261019; digests, index digests, root-table entries and the Q0 identity from the local smoke (smoke/smoke_local.json; exact, deterministic)

knownlog.layout: B's header layout: column j, s = 0..82: phi^s(R_j) [j, lambda^s mod r], -phi^s(R_j) [j, -lambda^s mod r]; checked against B's K600 header
knownlog.scalar_rule: splitmix64(seed), rejection below floor(2^64/r)*r, mod r, 0 rejected; the base of K columns uses the first K scalars

lead: survey lead L2 (known-log K600 base, LAnone); prior use experiments/koblitz-pair-claw-20260929/README.md:339-400

index_digest.source: B's unfolded index, protocol.json of koblitz-n83-state-fold-20261015; reproduced here by cP and cS on Q0 (smoke/)

q0_identity.source: inputs/archived_identities.json old17.q0 (run 38786433493); folded probes from koblitz-n83-state-fold-20261015 (Q0 smoke, cF) and smoke/ here

power.rule: smallest N in (20, 30, 40, 60) with median relative half-width <= 0.20 and P(lower bound > 1) >= 0.90 under both cost models

question: What is the end-to-end cold cost (base and log-table generation, base load, index build, log verification, self-tests and the one-target online interval) of a known-log factor base of seeded scalar orbits on the n=83 a=1 Koblitz curve, at the baseline's K600 and at the cost-model optimum K_opt, on new public points, and how far is it from the tuned rho rT770 and from the IC baseline measured in the same session?

reading_rule.invalid: any gate or control fails, or any scheduled row is missing (including time-guard skips)
reading_rule.measured_above_rho: the primary interval's lower bound exceeds 1
reading_rule.measured_below_rho: its upper bound is below 1 (would contradict the DKM bound for this generic method: audit the accounting before any claim)
reading_rule.never: no outcome of this experiment is an IC improvement or replaces the IC baseline row

row_label: SEPARATELY LABELLED REFERENCE ROW (owner's ruling 2026-10-19, 'Measure both, decide later'). It does not replace the n=83 index-calculus baseline row. Whether it may ever hold the IC row is decided after the L1 multiplier-closure result.

sources.producer: the rank-probe producer (koblitz-n83-rankprobe-20261019, the n=83 baseline row), unchanged

stage_tags: factor base: seeded scalar orbits (166 K points, K signed-Frobenius columns); PDP: the baseline's S3 root index (PDP4s3rootindex); relation collection: none; linear algebra: LAnone (all factor-base logs known, no final matrix); target: TDsingle; ISO0. The IC1 candidate manifest is minted when the row lands, not at freeze

statistics.e2e_cold: known-log arms: gen_ms (the generator's own clock) + cold_in_process_ms (the producer's, process start .. recovery check) per point; cP: cold_in_process_ms per point; kP+cP: mean rank stage of kP over the blocks + mean cP cold over the points; rT: setup + online per point
statistics.multiplicity: one primary estimate; every secondary is descriptive
statistics.primary: the reference measurement itself: G = mean E2E(cL220) / mean cold(rT) over the 40 cold points, 95% bootstrap interval (points resampled, paired, 10,000 draws, seed 20261019); with it the end-to-end cold S of cL220 = mean E2E / (this run's rT ms per step * sqrt(r)) with its interval (points resampled, unit held fixed)
secondary: end-to-end cold gaps to rT of kP+cP and cL600; cL600 / cL220
online gaps to rT of cL220, cL600 and cP; ns per probe per arm
mean phases per arm (generation, base load, index, self-test, log verification, online), peak RSS
probe-law ratios per arm; kP rank stage, attempts and ns per probe
the cost model's prediction beside the measurement (labelled a prediction)
statistics.secondary_labelled: E2E(kP+cP) / E2E(cL220), labelled 'reference, not an IC improvement' (blocks resampled, attempts resampled within blocks, points resampled paired)

success_criterion: AGENTS.md 'Success criterion: iterative improvement of the index-calculus baseline': this row is a reference beside the ratchet, not a step of it
what_it_is: With no relations, the known-log base reduces the method to generic baby-step giant-step on the Frobenius quotient: the index of pairs of base points is the baby-step table, the target scan the giant steps. It is bounded by the DKM non-adaptive line (crypto research/lit2026_w3_ggm_audit_20261011/README.md:177-183), so it can never beat rho. The measurement prices that limit; it is not an IC improvement.
